items.definition:
the act of moving downwards; ancestry
The plane began its slow descent towards the airport.

the act of removing or getting rid of something
The elimination of waste is crucial for environmental protection.

an association of people for mutual aid or the pursuit of a common goal
In medieval times, craftsmen often belonged to a guild.

the state of being unable to do something
His inability to focus affected his academic performance.

an experienced and trusted adviser
She found a great mentor who guided her through her career.

a standard or pattern
It's the norm for students to wear uniforms.

the general costs of running a business
We need to reduce our overhead costs.

a small firearm
The police officer carried a pistol.

a person who attacks an enemy in their territory
The raiders attacked the village at dawn.

an improvement in the condition or strength of something
The city is experiencing an economic revival.

a device that detects or measures a physical property
The car has a sensor to detect obstacles.

a person responsible for the funds of a society or club
The treasurer presented the financial report.

a man who has magical powers
The old wizard cast a powerful spell.

administrator or administration
Please contact the admin if you have any issues.

the height of an object or point in relation to sea level or ground level
The airplane reached an altitude of 30,000 feet.

scattered pieces of waste or remains
The street was covered in debris after the storm.

a group of delegates
A delegation from the company visited the new factory.

a person who gives something, especially money or blood
He became a blood donor after the accident.

the quality of being thankful; readiness to show appreciation for and to return kindness
He expressed his gratitude for their help.

a picture illustrating a book, newspaper, etc.
The book contained many beautiful illustrations.

a sign or signal that something exists or is true
High unemployment is an indicator of a weak economy.

the smallest unit of a chemical compound
A water molecule consists of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

a general description or plan
She drew an outline of the main points for her presentation.

the quality of being trustworthy or performing consistently well
The reliability of the new car model is excellent.

a person or business that sells goods to the public
The online retailer offers free shipping on all orders.

a display case; an event to present talent
The art gallery held a showcase of local artists' work.

the speed of something in a given direction
The rocket reached an incredible velocity as it ascended.

responsibility
The new policy aims to increase accountability among employees.

bullets, shells, etc.
The soldiers were running low on ammunition.

a song of praise or patriotism
The crowd stood for the national anthem.

a person who organizes activities
She works as a project coordinator.

the act of moving troops or equipment into position
The deployment of new software will happen next month.

the outer surface or structure
The exterior of the building needs painting.

a gun
The police officer carried a firearm.

extreme anger
He reacted with great fury to the news.

a Semitic language; a member of an ancient people
She is studying Hebrew at university.

protection from disease or legal obligation
Vaccination provides immunity against many diseases.

the act of setting someone free from imprisonment, slavery, or oppression
The liberation of the city was celebrated by all.

the state or fact of being likely; probability
There is a high likelihood of rain tomorrow.

an indiscriminate and brutal slaughter of people
The historical records describe a terrible massacre.

a person who advocates political independence for a country
He was a strong nationalist who believed in his country's sovereignty.

a person who is among the first to explore or settle a new country or area
Marie Curie was a pioneer in the field of radioactivity.

the state of being successful, especially financially
The country enjoyed a period of great prosperity.

a condition of being safe or sheltered from pursuit, danger, or trouble
The old building served as a refuge during the storm.

public support for a cause
She is involved in environmental advocacy.

the consequences of an event
The city was rebuilt in the aftermath of the earthquake.

hostile or violent behavior
His aggression led to a fight.

a military unit; a group of people
The fire brigade arrived quickly.

the act of burying a dead body
The family attended the burial.

a leading dignitary of the Roman Catholic Church; a type of bird
The cardinal wore a red robe.

the quality of being clear
He spoke with great clarity.

the organization of different elements
Good coordination is essential for team success.

a prolonged period of abnormally low rainfall
The region is experiencing a severe drought.

height above a given level; the action of raising something
The town is at an elevation of 1,000 meters.

respect and admiration
He held his mentor in high esteem.

a type of image file that can be animated
She sent me a funny GIF of a cat.

an expert in or student of history
The historian spent years researching ancient civilizations.

the friendly and generous reception and entertainment of guests, visitors, or strangers
They showed great hospitality to their foreign guests.

a person seized or held as security for the fulfillment of a condition
The police negotiated for the release of the hostage.

the ability to read and write
Promoting literacy is crucial for societal development.

a person who moves from one place to another, especially in order to find work or better living conditions
Many economic migrants seek opportunities abroad.

the state of being obsessed with someone or something; an idea or thought that continually preoccupies or intrudes on a person's mind
He has an obsession with collecting rare stamps.

a liquid mixture of hydrocarbons that is present in certain rock strata and can be extracted and refined to produce fuels including gasoline, kerosene, and diesel oil; crude oil
Petroleum is a major source of energy.

a movement or development toward a destination or a more advanced state
We observed a steady progression in his language skills.
